CLI Reference
🔒

End-to-End Encrypted

XChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption on all shared content. Ed25519 identity keys. Zero-knowledge architecture.

🌐

Peer-to-Peer

Files transfer directly between devices via BitTorrent, DHT, mDNS, and WebRTC. No cloud storage, no middlemen.

🧩

Extensible

30+ extensions for sync, chat, discovery, VFS, streaming, and more. Build your own with the Extension API.

💻

Cross-Platform

Desktop app (Windows, macOS, Linux), CLI tool, web dashboard, and mobile app. Works on LAN and WAN.

🔑

Self-Sovereign Identity

Your identity is an Ed25519 keypair derived from a 24-word mnemonic. No accounts, no servers, no sign-up.

📡

Works Offline

Core features work without internet. LAN sharing via mDNS, local sync, encrypted chat between nearby devices.
